title: Face Bands for Term Life Insurance Back Installments Billed for Reinstatement
content:
**Band ladder — Term Life Insurance back installments billed for reinstatement.** The band factor applied to the face premium is read from the band measurement face:

| Band measurement face (USD) | Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term, or any policy past its level premium period | Level term policy within its level premium period |
|---|---|---|
| 1000000 or more | 0.82 | 0.74 |
| from 500000 up to 1000000 | 0.86 | 0.80 |
| from 250000 up to 500000 | 0.92 | 0.88 |
| below 250000 | 1.00 | 1.00 |

A level term policy is past its level premium period once the whole months from its issue date to today reach twelve times its premium guarantee period in years.

**Questions of reading.**

*Which column does an Ashgrove Level Term 10 issued 11 years ago read?* The left column: 132 whole months exceed 120.

*What factor does a band measurement face of exactly 250000 take on a level term policy in its 3rd year?* 0.88; 249999 takes 1.00.
